description: The first tool to call for any question about how a site is doing on Google. Returns total clicks, impressions, CTR and average position for the period against the period before (totals match the Search Console UI), the pages that gained and lost the most clicks, and up to 3 plain-language things to do now. For custom breakdowns use search_performance instead. Read-only.

days.description: Length of the period in days, 7 to 480, ending about 3 days ago because Google data lags. It is compared with the same number of days right before it. Default 28.

site.description: The Search Console property to read. Accepts "example.com", "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com". Call list_sites first if unsure which properties exist.

name: site_overview
title: Site overview
